He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee Volunteers]] and [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor Bears]]. ==Early life and high school== Carr initially attended [[Manhattan High School]] in [[Manhattan, Kansas]]. He averaged averaged 10.9 points and four rebounds per game as a sophomore.{{cite web|url=https://themercury.com/sports/manhattan-high-basketballs-cameron-carr-transferring-to-link-academy/article_abb924d3-bf68-568c-8eee-1b6e3b05e2ba.html|title=‘A really tough situation’ Manhattan High basketball's Cameron Carr transferring to Link Academy|first=Jimmy|last=Watkins|work=[[The Manhattan Mercury]]|date=June 1, 2021|access-date=November 11, 2025}} After his sophomore year, Carr transferred to [[Link Academy (Missouri)|Link Academy]] in [[Branson, Missouri]].{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/prospect-profiles/nba-draft-scouting-report-tennessees-cameron-carr|title=NBA Draft Scouting Report: Tennessee's Cameron Carr|website=[[SI.com]]|date=September 24, 2023|access-date=November 11, 2025}} Carr was rated a four-star recruit and committed to play college basketball at Tennessee over offers from Kansas State, Northwestern, and Virginia.{{cite web|url=https://www.knoxnews.com/story/sports/college/university-of-tennessee/mens-basketball/2022/11/08/cameron-carr-tennessee-basketball-recruiting-2023-class-commit/69628507007/|title=Tennessee basketball picks up four-star guard Cameron Carr in 2023 class|first=Mike|last=Wilson|work=[[Knoxville News Sentinel]]|date=November 8, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2025}} ==College career== Carr began his [[college basketball]] career at Tennessee.{{cite web|url=https://www.knoxnews.com/story/sports/college/university-of-tennessee/mens-basketball/2023/12/05/cameron-carr-tennessee-basketball-rick-barnes-george-mason/71707396007/?gnt-cfr=1&gca-cat=p&gca-uir=true&gca-epti=z119072d00----v119072b00xxxxd11xx65&gca-ft=170&gca-ds=sophi|title=How Cameron Carr made 'one of the best plays' of the year for Tennessee basketball|first=Mike|last=Wilson|work=[[Knoxville News Sentinel]]|date=December 5, 2023|access-date=November 11, 2025}} He averaged 1.6 points per game over 14 games played as a freshman.{{cite web|url=https://www.on3.com/teams/tennessee-volunteers/news/tennessee-vols-basketball-cam-carr-sophomore-leap-nba-scout/|title=NBA Scout: Tennessee Basketball's Cam Carr looks 'poised for a sophomore leap'|first=Grant|last=Ramey|website=On3.com|date=July 7, 2024|access-date=November 11, 2025}} Carr suffered a thumb injury four games into his sophomore season.{{cite web|url=https://www.knoxnews.com/story/sports/college/university-of-tennessee/mens-basketball/2024/11/21/cam-carr-injury-update-left-thumb-tennessee-basketball-virginia/76342534007/|title=Tennessee basketball's Cam Carr will miss 4 to 6 weeks with left thumb injury |first=Mike|last=Wilson|work=[[Knoxville News Sentinel]]|date=November 21, 2024|access-date=November 11, 2025}} In December 2024 he abruptly left the program and entered the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web|url=https://www.knoxnews.com/story/sports/college/university-of-tennessee/mens-basketball/2024/12/23/cam-carr-transfer-tennessee-basketball-rick-barnes-quit/76976108007/?gnt-cfr=1&gca-cat=p&gca-uir=true&gca-epti=z11xx72p007698n11----c11----d00----v11xx72b0087xxd118765&gca-ft=182&gca-ds=sophi|title=What Rick Barnes said about Cam Carr leaving Tennessee basketball: 'He just walked out'|first=Mike|last=Wilson|work=[[Knoxville News Sentinel]]|date=December 23, 2024|access-date=November 11, 2025}} Carr committed to transfer to Baylor.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/tennessee/men-s-basketball/cameron-carr-commits-to-baylor-after-leaving-tennessee-basketball-mid-season-01jjak1x56qj|title=Cameron Carr Commits to Baylor After Leaving Tennessee Basketball Mid-Season|first=Tanner|last=Johnson|website=[[SI.com]]|date=January 23, 2025|access-date=November 11, 2025}} He averaged 18.9 points, 5.8 rebounds and 2.4 assists per game. Carr declared for the [[2026 NBA draft]] after the season.{{cite news |last1=Knoop |first1=Trent |title=Baylor Star Cameron Carr Makes NBA Draft Decision |url=https://www.si.com/college/baylor/basketball/baylor-star-cameron-carr-makes-nba-draft-decision |access-date=April 17, 2026 |work=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=April 14, 2026}} ==National team career== Carr was a part of the Baylor team chosen to represent the United States in the [[Basketball at the 2025 Summer World University Games|2025 Summer World University Games]] in Germany.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/baylor/basketball/cameron-carr-obi-agbim-propel-team-usa-past-finland-in-quarterfinal-duel-fisu-games|title=Cameron Carr, Obi Agbim propel Team USA past Finland in Quarterfinal duel|first=Trent|last=Knoop|website=[[SI.com]]|date=July 23, 2025|access-date=November 11, 2025}} ==Personal life== Carr's father, [[Chris Carr (basketball)|Chris Carr]], played six seasons in the [[National Basketball Association]] and is currently an assistant basketball coach at [[Drury Panthers men's basketball|Drury University]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/tennessee/article/tennessee-vols-basketball-wes-rucker-cameron-carr-swallowing-pride-embracing-different-role-as-tennessee-freshman-rick-barnes-dalton-knecht-josiah-jordan-james-226931429/|title=Carr
